name: list_appointments
description: MUST call when the identified patient asks to reschedule or cancel. Reuse the caller_full_name already established earlier in the conversation; never ask for it again. Include patient_id when still available, otherwise the backend permits only an exact unique full-name match. Returns upcoming BOOKED appointments and their real appointment IDs; never invent an appointment_id.

patient_id.description: Patient UUID from lookup_patient when still available; never invent it.

caller_full_name.description: Exact full name already established by lookup_patient. Reuse it silently; do not ask again.

upcoming_only.description: Defaults to true: only future booked appointments.
